title: Example Café menu
description: The menu a guest opens from the QR code on the table at Example Café: dishes by category with diet tags, allergens and prices, and how to find the café.

intent.purpose: Diners at a table check dishes, diet tags and prices on their phone before they order.
intent.audience: A guest who scanned the QR code on the table
intent.successCriteria: A guest finds a dish that suits their diet, what is in it and its price in two taps

theme.direction: Warm cream and espresso, rounded corners, large type for a phone held at the table

surfaces.name: Menu
surfaces.purpose: Browse one category at a time and narrow it by one or more diets

surfaces.name: Dish
surfaces.purpose: Read one dish: picture, diet, allergens and price

surfaces.name: Visit
surfaces.purpose: Opening hours, address, a call link, a sketch map and a note for groups

surfaces.name: Not found
surfaces.purpose: The in-shell page an unknown address or dish id meets, with the way back to the menu
